trade_journal.note: manually placed and manually closed via TradingView paper account -- stop executed on price touch (wick to 80,203.9), not candle close

Manually placed and closed on TradingView. Peak unrealized profit reached ~$3.88 (price dipped to 97.48) before reversing all the way back through the old 1.5x-ATR trailing stop. This is exactly the giveback problem that led to reworking the trail/take-profit logic (tighter ATR trail + profit-lock floor + fixed take-profit heuristic) -- that improved logic wasn't live yet when this trade happened, so it didn't get the benefit.
